exactness: integer sets, labelled rooted topology and literal original directed edge IDs/endpoints; zero tolerance
plants: identical rho-rooted ((a,b),c): empty cut has identical yielded signature and optimum 0
rho-rooted ((a,b),c) versus ((a,c),b): empty cuts are not an AF; optimum is 1
cut e_a from rho-rooted ((a,b),c): components a and rho-(b,c), suppressed edge into a,b parent is not unchanged
zero cuts preserve every edge of a reduced rooted tree; all cuts yield exactly singleton labels
corruptions: swap b and c in one of the identical-tree signatures; equality comparator must reject
claim suppressed corridor edge retained unchanged; literal ID/endpoints comparator must reject
delete either required final pendant cut in frozen 2B fixture; AF comparator must reject
failure_policy: stop on unexpected detector output, retain receipt, diagnose before continuing
timing: run controls and one frozen instance as measured pilot; only then extend finite geometry family
independence: fresh code; stdlib only; no author or previous reviewer evaluator imports; frozen target/data are shared inputs, not independent evidence of source transcription
